tool_calls.name: /bin/zsh -lc "cat core/discov/config.go && sed -n '260,340p' core/discov/internal/registry.go && sed -n '1,180p' core/discov/internal/etcdclient.go && sed -n '1,120p' core/discov/config_test.go && find .. -name PROJECT_BRIEF.md -o -name AGENTS.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"DialClient\\(|NewRegistry|NewPublisher|NewSubscriber|EtcdConf|DialTimeout\" core/discov --glob '*.go' && sed -n '1,180p' core/discov/registry.go && sed -n '1,160p' core/discov/publisher.go && sed -n '1,160p' core/discov/subscriber.go"
/bin/zsh -lc "cat core/discov/publisher.go && cat core/discov/subscriber.go && rg -n \"NewSubscriber\\(|NewPublisher\\(\" --glob '*.go' . | head -100 && cat go.mod | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' core/discov/internal/registry.go && rg -n \"Hosts|Key\" zrpc/config.go zrpc/internal/resolver/discovbuilder.go core/discov --glob '*.go' | head -120 && rg -n \"Etcd:\" --glob '*.yaml' --glob '*.yml' --glob '*.json' --glob '*.md' . | head -100"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,140p' zrpc/client.go && rg -n \"buildDiscov|DiscovScheme|Authority\" zrpc --glob '*.go' && sed -n '210,250p' core/discov/internal/registry.go && rg -n \"NewSubscriber|DialClient|GetConn\" --glob '*_test.go' core/discov/internal"
/bin/zsh -lc "cat zrpc/internal/target.go && cat zrpc/internal/resolver/resolver.go && sed -n '1,90p' core/discov/internal/registry_test.go && rg -n \"BuildDiscovTarget\""

/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w core/discov/config.go core/discov/internal/registry.go core/discov/subscriber.go zrpc/client.go zrpc/internal/target.go zrpc/internal/resolver/discovbuilder.go && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- core/discov/config.go core/discov/internal/registry.go core/discov/subscriber.go zrpc/client.go zrpc/internal/target.go zrpc/internal/resolver/discovbuilder.go'
/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w core/discov/publisher.go core/discov/internal/registry.go zrpc/internal/rpcpubserver.go zrpc/server.go && git diff --check && git status --short'
